snapshot: Before is the frozen browser-choice v2 explicit-browser skill. After is the current product skill. The only two differing files are scenario-design.md and verification-rules.md, and their diff is the overlapping asynchronous V1 completion guidance. Evals are excluded from both snapshots. The shared reviewer, fixture, model, container, approvals, scorer, and fault operators are unchanged.
schedule: Three fresh paired repetitions of the public spent v3-13 search-race task, one worker, alternating arm order before/after, after/before, before/after. No previous generated test is reused.
common_prompt_appendix: Additional explicit command approvals for BOTH arms: the already-approved project-local Playwright CLI prefix may use --browser chromium, --config <outside-worktree guard JSON>, and -s=<fresh unique session> for the skill's origin-guarded exploration only. Its named eval and requests subcommands for the skill's blocked-origin proof are approved, as is goto on the exact preflighted app origin. Creating that guard config outside the target worktree is approved. This does not approve another origin, a package install, changing project controls, skipping the preflight, or terminating a process the invocation did not start. Record these exact command rows as already approved. Follow the unchanged skill safety gate, guard, V4/V5/V6, and completion rules in both arms.

decision_rule.primary: Independent scorer's f2-stale-response-wins kill on each newly generated spec. Directional signal requires at least two of three after kills, more after kills than before kills, and all after clean 3/3, refactor survival, zero P0, no timeout, no out-of-scope writes, and self-reported complete. Every other seeded fault must have no aggregate after-kill decline. Any infrastructure attempt or incomplete cell makes the result inconclusive.
decision_rule.secondary: Report all six fault vectors, per-arm fault-kill counts, parent-attempt usage, and paired elapsed differences descriptively. No speed or cost threshold or savings claim is defined.
decision_rule.interpretation: A three-pair public-development signal cannot prove causation, non-inferiority, release readiness, actual V4/V6 correctness, billed cost, or generalization to other tasks.

prerequisite_probe: Reuse the pinned image's passing model-free successor probe for explicit Chromium CLI, pre-dispatch origin rejection, owned cleanup, and clean smoke tests.
process_audit: Actual V4 and V6 correctness require transcript adjudication; tool counters and self-reports do not prove compliance.
